correctness.rationale: For all m>=1, affine-coordinate derivation (s,x) gives exact branch constraints and exhaustive positive-area adjacency graph AB,AD,BA,CA. Every length-2m admissible word is among the four explicitly integrated families. The AB,BA sections have width (1/4-(4m-1)|delta|)_+; both transients have width min(2epsilon,1/4-(4m-3)epsilon)_+. Their exact integrals yield the displayed rational formula. The odd-n asymptotic follows by monotone squeeze. Independent exact rational polygon clipping reproduces all four component formulas for m=1..60; this tests, but is not substituted for, the general affine inequalities. Null boundary handling is explicit.

value.rationale: The map is a canonical nonmonotonic area-preserving shear system with neutral parabolic period-two lines and only polynomial decay of correlations. A quantitatively precise full-branch residence-time tail is a natural diagnostic of the parabolic bottleneck. The exact coefficient 1/16 and global 4-cylinder finite-n distribution distinguish asymptotic strength and transient contributions, going beyond the known qualitative 1/n mixing exponent. It does not claim a new correlation coefficient.
